puzzle.hint: The declaration of Prophet Isa (Jesus) affirming that Allah alone is worthy of worship and that this is the straight path.
puzzle.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
puzzle.verseEn: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
